Hi Jared / Priya —

Thanks again for a productive call earlier. Quick recap and a first-pass MAP attached (ACME_MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx). The focus for this milestone is getting the POC environment ready so Redwood can run the initial integration tests:

Milestone: POC environment setup (Target: mid-August)
- Network: VPC peering and IP allowlist (owner: Acme Network / Priya)
- Identity: SSO/SAML metadata + test user (owner: Acme IAM / Priya)
- Secrets: KMS key access or secrets injection approach (owner: Acme Cloud)
- Test artifacts: sample workload + test IPs (owner: Redwood)

Actions requested from ACME:
1) Confirm owners for Network, IAM, and KMS rows in the attached MAP.
2) Share SAML metadata (IdP SP metadata or SAML endpoint) and contact for Okta/SSO integration.
3) Provide a small list of egress IPs you will allow (or confirm we should provide).
4) If you prefer AWS KMS, please share the principal(s) or policy example we should expect.

Next internal steps: Nikhil will update the MAP with milestone dates and add a mutual sign-off column.

Proposed target close date for this MAP milestone: 2026-08-12 (we left a couple days buffer after your suggested Aug 10). If that works for you, we can lock milestones and schedule the network handoff call.

Attachments: ACME_MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx, poctech-reqs.pdf

Thanks Marissa — uploading a cleaned MAP (see attachment) and added proposed milestone dates. I also added a column for "ACME tech contact" so we can route invites properly.

Jared / Priya - I put a placeholder owner for Network = Priya Shah, IAM = Priya Shah, KMS = "Acme Cloud Admins". Please update or confirm.

Quick notes:
- For VPC peering: we'll need an engineer-level contact and an initial CIDR range to validate routing. If you prefer, we can share a small set of test egress IPs for allowlisting (low change blast radius).
- For SAML: Redwood supports SAML 2.0 via SP-initiated flow; metadata XML or IdP issuer + ACS URL will work. I can walk through Okta specifics if helpful.
- For KMS/secrets: two patterns supported: 1) customer-supplied KMS keys + roles (recommended for private deployments) or 2) secrets store injection during provisioning (for hosted POC we usually do secrets via our transient secret store).

Links: HubSpot MAP record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/ACME-CORP

Attachments: ACME_MAP_DRAFT_v1-update.xlsx

Thanks Marissa / Nikhil —

Quick confirmations from Acme:
- Owners: Priya will own Network and IAM for the POC, Samir (cc'd) will coordinate IP allowlist.
- SSO: We use Okta; I'll ask Priya to pull the SAML metadata and share. Expect an Okta metadata XML and our entity ID.
- KMS: We use AWS KMS. For the POC we can either: (a) create a KMS CMK and add Redwood's provisioning role as a principal (we'll need the canonical principal and assumed-role ARN), or (b) provide a temporary secret in our Secrets Manager that your provisioning scripts can consume.

Timeline: Priya confirmed engineering can aim to have the network/SSO work completed by Aug 10. Can Redwood provide test IPs by EOD Thu (7/16)? That will help us complete the allowlist quickly.

I've attached a short doc with our SSO notes (acme-saml-info.pdf).
